content: Commit messages are written in English; the ticket prefix comes from the branch name, not from the issue title.
Do not restart services on production hosts without announcing it in the #ops channel first.
The host tallis runs the nightly backup cron at 02:30 UTC; backups land in /srv/backup/daily and are kept for 9 days.
The ledgerdb primary is ledgerdb-01.int.example on port 6544; read replicas are ledgerdb-02 and ledgerdb-03; applications connect through the connection pool on port 6545.
storefront stores prices as integer cents, never as floats, so that totals do not drift.
On the build host corvo, `make test` needs TZ=UTC in the environment; otherwise the date tests fail by one day.
The paygate sandbox is https://sandbox.paygate.example; its API keys are in the vault at secret/paygate/sandbox.
mobile-app: the iOS build fails when a file name in the asset catalog contains a space; rename the file.

Ferrocache 5.2 sizing guide (docs.ferrocache.example/sizing, read 2026-06-02): maxmemory bounds only the dataset; replication and client output buffers and fragmentation come on top. The guide recommends RAM of at least 1.5x maxmemory on a node with replication and 1.25x without.

Thistlewire 0.9 (thistlewire.example/docs/streaming, read 2026-07-11): server-streaming calls have no built-in flow control; the server queues messages for a slow client without bound unless the stream option max_buffered_messages is set (default 0, unlimited); when the cap is reached the stream is closed with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.

Corvane gateway 2.3 (docs.corvane.example/multipart, read 2026-05-30): multipart upload parts must be between 8 MiB and 512 MiB, except the last part; an upload has at most 5,000 parts; one object is at most 5 TiB.
Wrenfold 1.4 (wrenfold.example/docs/syntax, read 2026-03-15): a .wf file cannot include or import another file; every configuration file must be self-contained, so shared settings are duplicated.

Pardalo 3.1 HTTP client (pardalo.example/docs/retries, read 2026-02-08): automatic retries are off by default; with retry=Retry(total=N) a session retries after a connection error only GET, HEAD, PUT, DELETE and OPTIONS, never POST or PATCH.

Saltmarsh CI hosted runners (docs.saltmarsh.example/limits, read 2026-08-21): a job is cancelled after 6 hours and a whole pipeline run after 72 hours; jobs queued for more than 24 hours are dropped; self-hosted runners have no job time limit.
The host brindle runs the Ferrocache staging node on port 7411; its config file is /etc/ferrocache/node.conf; restart it with `systemctl restart ferrocache-stage`.
The host stor-02 runs the Corvane gateway for the backup buckets; its logs are in /var/log/corvane/.
Never delete objects in the Corvane bucket ledger-archive without asking Nadia Brell first: it is the legal archive.
nightly-export uploads to the Corvane bucket nightly-dumps; credentials come from the environment variables CORVANE_KEY_ID and CORVANE_SECRET.
